task_description: Create LTX23_Director_2_0_MV_Colab.py - a complete production-quality Python implementation that executes the LTX-2.3 Director 2.0 MV Workflow inside Google Colab/ComfyUI on Tesla T4 with memory-managed chunked generation, two-stage sampling, checkpoint/resume, and FFmpeg assembly

verification.summary: File passes Python ast.parse syntax check. 3367 lines of complete implementation. Contains 9 classes (LTX23Config, MemoryManager, TimelineSegment, CheckpointManager, PerformanceLogger, ChunkProcessor, LTX23DirectorPipeline, ComfyUIAPIFallback, LTX23DirectPipeline). 58 NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS references, 47 EXECUTE_NORMALIZED calls. All required features present: two-stage sampling, 4 LoRAs with correct strengths, LTXDirector nodes, dynamic chunk sizing, OOM detection/retry, checkpoint/resume, FFmpeg assembly, test mode, dual execution mode.
